items.placement_heading: 内容无害不等于更新无害：过滤器还要预测 Training Effect
items.semantic_spine: content/topic filtering remains the old baseline; compliance-vector projection at safety-critical layers is owned by the dataset filter artifact, with probe cost, drift/correlation failure, canary fallback and exact-v1 model/data limits retained

items.placement_heading: Adapter 约束会让 Token Credit 退化为少数 Residual Direction
items.semantic_spine: output-distribution token signals can degenerate under LoRA; the credit owner measures concentration and adapter-enabled/disabled hidden-state residuals while the outcome reward retains correctness authority, with extra-forward/path-consistency cost, noise failure, sequence/group fallback and compact-sweep limits

items.placement_heading: Arrival Bias 与 Stale Direction 是两种独立误差
items.semantic_spine: arrival-frequency correction does not repair stale direction; outer momentum supplies a current-trajectory reference before the outer update, with source-step/correction identity, lag and variance costs, stale-update failure and synchronization/drop fallback

items.placement_heading: Bit-exact Replay 可以脱离同型硬件，但不能脱离数值路径身份
items.semantic_spine: same-hardware replay is relaxed by software emulation only for covered numeric paths; evaluation owns the frozen arithmetic/reduction/router identity, with unsupported-op failure, hardware/tolerance fallback and explicit non-security/non-performance boundary

items.placement_heading: Foundation Evidence 只有通过 Class-calibrated Gate 才能修改 Persistent Map
items.semantic_spine: unchecked semantic claims cannot share geometric commit authority; the persistent-map owner applies per-class calibration, conflict-drop, quarantine and provenance, while the VLA consumes committed revisions, with sparse-calibration/identity failure and geometry-only or human fallback

items.placement_heading: Replay Ratio 从固定超参数演进为可迁移 Controller
items.semantic_spine: fixed replay mixtures ignore evolving forgetting; a proxy learns a masked controller transferred frozen to the target trainer, with controller/proxy/compatibility identity, proxy-mirroring and validation-stream failure, conservative-mixture fallback and bounded task-horizon evidence

items.placement_heading: Process Reward Model 成为 Sensor 前，先测试 Transformation Stability
items.semantic_spine: natural-trace accuracy alone is insufficient for a load-bearing PRM; evaluation owns label-preserving transformation tests and receipts while outcome truth and release authority stay separate, with transformation-oracle error, false positives, abstention/original-benchmark fallback and math-only limits

items.placement_heading: Search Query 本身也是 Public Egress Action
items.semantic_spine: final-answer filtering misses query-side exfiltration and mosaic composition; the privacy/egress owner gates and logs public queries, with utility/latency/false-reject cost, cumulative leakage failure, private-search/approval fallback and benchmark-specific limits

items.placement_heading: Policy-level Explorer 只拥有 Proposal，不拥有 Update Truth
items.semantic_spine: token-level randomness can create incoherent trajectories; a smaller policy owns proposal diversity while the target/verifier owns scoring and updates, with off-policy/support/schedule failure, target-policy sampling fallback and tested math-model boundaries

items.placement_heading: Near-free Parallelism 只能消费不进入 Critical Path 的 Slack
items.semantic_spine: memory-bound slack alone overpredicts safe parallelism; the execution runtime profiles kernel-granularity and resource admission while Ch48 retains speculative correctness, with drift/contention/tail failure, serial or narrower fallback and fixed backend/tolerance limits

items.placement_heading: Model Routing 与 Test-time Scaling 必须结算同一个 Budget
items.semantic_spine: independent routing and TTS leave cross-dimensional quality/cost choices unowned; the scheduler jointly selects endpoint and budget online, with exploration/calibration/drift/tail cost, fixed-policy fallback and verifier/eFLOPs evidence limits

items.placement_heading: Harness Backdoor 把单次写入变成跨 Run 控制状态
items.semantic_spine: per-run harmful-action checks miss planted durable control state; security owns write provenance, attribution, lifecycle scanning, quarantine/revoke/rollback, with signature miss/semantic false positives/backup failure, immutable or ephemeral fallback and benchmark limits

items.placement_heading: Video Ingestion State 与 Decode KV 是两个不同 Cache Object
items.semantic_spine: retaining all visual KV makes video prefill quadratic; StateKV separates fixed recurrent construction state from detailed decode cache with explicit model/frame/RoPE identity, selector-quality and break-even costs, assumption failure, FullKV/sliding fallback and tested-backbone limits
